messages.text: ok i got the history recorder hooked up to your kv layer. using wing & gong's linearizability checker logic since it handles concurrent ops nicely.
nice. did you feed it a random mix of reads and writes or just sequential? want to make sure the interleaving actually stresses the commit path.
random mix, 50/50. but wait. why is read returning old data after a write committed on the leader? that shouldn't happen if log replication worked.
hmm. let me check the kv store code real quick. probably the apply loop isn't flushing the memtable before acking the read. give me 2 mins.
ok standing by. if it's the memtable flush, we might need a barrier there or the linearizability tests will fail every time there's a concurrent read.
yep, found it. was missing a wait for the latest log entry before serving reads. just pushed a fix to main. can you rerun the checker?
rerunning now... okay that actually passed this time. weird how one missing sync call breaks everything.
yeah, classic distributed systems bug. glad you caught it with the checker instead of waiting for jepsen to scream at us later.
